en.headline: Po Pin Chau trail booking trial starts this weekend
en.dek: Visitors heading to the High Island Geo-Trail section at Sai Kung East Dam between 9am and 5pm today and Sunday need a free, named reservation under a 2,000-person daily cap.
body: A trial booking system for the Po Pin Chau section of the High Island Geo-Trail at the East Dam of High Island Reservoir in Sai Kung began this morning, the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said.

On specified weekends, the Mid-Autumn Festival period and National Day Golden Week from 5 September to 7 October, anyone entering that section between 9am and 5pm must reserve a two-hour slot in advance. Each slot holds 500 people and the daily total is 2,000, allocated first come, first served. Booking is free during the trial and is required only for the Po Pin Chau section; the East Dam itself and other stretches of the geo-trail remain open without a reservation. Entry before 9am or after 5pm, and on days outside the published list, also needs no booking.

Reservations are made under a real-name system on the Klook platform designated by the department. Each person may book up to five places, and a change of plan can be cancelled up to 48 hours beforehand. Visitors must show an electronic voucher and matching identity document at the entrance. The department said walk-up visitors may still book on the day if places remain, and staff will be on site to help.

Assistant Director of Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation (Country Parks) To Man-wai said the trial is meant to protect the path, test its carrying capacity and spread visitors across the day. She said the two-kilometre return walk typically takes about two hours, and the department would release unused places if no-shows leave spare capacity. No penalty or fee applies at this stage; the department will review the arrangement after the trial.

zh.headline: 破邊洲段預約制今起試行 每日名額二千
zh.dek: 西貢萬宜東壩地質步道破邊洲段今明兩日上午九時至下午五時須免費實名預約，每兩小時一段、每日合共二千人。
body: 漁農自然護理署今日起在西貢萬宜水庫東壩「萬宜地質步道—破邊洲段」試行預約制度，以控制人流及減少山徑損耗。
由9月5日至10月7日期間的周末、中秋及國慶黃金周，上午8時至下午5時進入該段必須預先預約。每兩小時為一個時段，每時段500人，每日合共2,000人，先到先得。試行期間預約免費，而且只適用於破邊洲段；東壩其他範圈及地質步道其餘路段均無須預約。指定日子上午9時前或下午5時後入段，亦無須預約。
公眾須經漁護署指定的Klook平台以實名登記，每人每次最多可為自己及同行者預訂五個名額，出發48小時前可取消。到場須出示電子憑證及身分證明。署方表示，當日若網上仍有餘額，現場亦可補預約，並會設資訊站及職員協助。
漁護署助理署長（郊野公園）陶文慧早前表示，試行旨在保護山徑、測試承載量及把訪客分流到不同時段。她指路段來回約兩公里，一般兩小時內可走完；若有人預約後未到，署方會視乎情况適時放出名額。現階段不設罰款或收費，署方會在試行後再作檢討。
